card.name: Small words in environment and resource texts
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, by, the, said, such, are) in general-web passages on forestry, energy, land use and environmental science. Not in drug-label text.

modes.label: Linking words
modes.description: Prepositions or connectors in the middle of a clause about land, forests or energy.
modes.example: conservation<< of>> hay and silage rarely practised.

modes.label: Attribution words
modes.description: Words naming or quoting a researcher in environmental news.
modes.example: is very important because this is when soils are replenished with water,"<< said>> Yang Chen of UC Irvine.

card.writes: It slightly favors 'gas' and similar tokens and disfavors 'bio' tokens, so it nudges toward energy and gas words rather than biology words.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in articles about forests, energy and the environment.
